system.story: The tracker and the killing shot; a Wereraven never loses a quarry.

description.value:
Method: Hunter (Quarry). The tracker and the killing shot.

Quarry

Your Mark also functions as a track: you always know a Marked target's direction and distance. Your first strike against a Marked target each round gains extra reach or a damage bump.

Bonus skill and contact

You gain Survival or Tracking and a ganger or street-guide contact.

Favored Kit

Longshot (the sniper's Kit; loves Overwatch Shot).
